page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines; an engraved emblem (woodcut vignette) in the middle with banners and motto below it, no margins with text.

main_text.l: A. diem XIII. Junii, urbi huic funestum,

page.notes: The title page is set with mixed type: the author line and "ORATIO" are large capitals, "DICTA" and the place lines are italic or small capitals. The emblem is a woodcut of a seated figure beneath a tree, with banners reading "PALLAS", "AEQUITAS"/"SEMPER", "OSTA" and the motto "HONOS ALIT ARTES". The motto and banner words are partly illegible in the scan and are not transcribed. The date in the printed form is "cIↄ Iↄ c LXXIV" which is rendered as MDCLXXIV. The second line "&c." is printed as a ampersand-curl form, transcribed as "&c." with some doubt. A faint library pencil note at top right is not transcribed.
